A person is standing in a lift. The lift is moving downwards at constant speed.
Which statement about the force exerted by the lift floor on the person’s feet is correct?
A
It is zero.
B
It is less than the person’s weight.
C
It is equal to the person’s weight.
D
It is greater than the person’s weight.

options.label: B
options.text: It is less than the person’s weight.

options.label: C
options.text: It is equal to the person’s weight.

options.label: D
options.text: It is greater than the person’s weight.
